theorem after_eq_before (request : Result Outcome) (w : host_weights.Weights) (kappa : E) :
    (request >>= fun event => PV_B2_F_MaterializeFrozen.original event w kappa) =
      original request w kappa

theorem complete_result (request : Result Outcome) (w : host_weights.Weights) (kappa : E) :
    PV_B2_F_AllocationEffects.copied request w kappa = original request w kappa

theorem source (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (request : Result Outcome)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base) (selected base request ops) w kappa =
      PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.mapResult mapRust
        (PV_B2_F_MaterializeRequest.original request w (fromNative kappa))

theorem nonvacuity (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    ∃ out, @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base)
      (selected base (ok .supplied) ops) w kappa = ok (.Ok out)

theorem allocation_error (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base)
      (selected base (ok .denied) ops) w kappa = ok (.Err ProverRwFull.verifier.Error.Allocation)

theorem failure (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (e : Error)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base)
      (selected base (fail e) ops) w kappa = fail e

theorem divergence (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base)
      (selected base div ops) w kappa = div

theorem three_rows (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (request : Result Outcome)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base))
    (b : PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.Bytes) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op249 (types base) (selected base request ops) b =
      PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.mapResult PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.toNative
        (PV_B2_E_GammaOriginal.originalGamma b) ∧
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op250 (types base) (selected base request ops) b =
      PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.mapResult PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.toNative
        (PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.original b) ∧
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base) (selected base request ops) w kappa =
      PV_B2_E_OrdinaryOriginal.mapResult mapRust
        (PV_B2_F_MaterializeRequest.original request w (fromNative kappa))

ambient_context: Every base ExternalTypes; op25 instantiated to the exact four-field weights structure. Every request : Result Outcome, ops in that carrier, weight and native kappa. No success/canonicality/source-equality premise.
nonvacuity: All weights/kappas succeed for ok supplied. ok denied yields exactly native Error::Allocation; fail e and div are preserved. Source kernel success is unconditional. This does not assert every native allocation succeeds.
native_link_evidence_class: Reviewed structural source/caller argument plus universal Lean Result equality for every allocation-request context and exact selected native-carrier installation; not fresh Aeneas extraction of the original mutable iterator and not a native execution/OS proof
native_limits: Selected candidate source/callback row only; the request is universally quantified, not a new trust item or success premise. Actual native RunJoin installation, OS-failure witness independence and L1/L2/L3 remain P obligations.

theorem heap_source (heap : HeapRequest) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    heapCallback heap w kappa = heapOriginal heap w kappa

theorem box_source (box : BoxRequest) (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    boxCallback box v alpha z = boxOriginal box v alpha z

theorem selected_heap (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (heap : HeapRequest) (box : BoxRequest)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base) (selected base heap box ops) w kappa =
      heapOriginal heap w kappa

theorem selected_box (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (heap : HeapRequest) (box : BoxRequest)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op252 (types base) (selected base heap box ops) v alpha z =
      boxOriginal box v alpha z

theorem dictionaries (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes) (heap : HeapRequest) (box : BoxRequest)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) :
    selected base heap box ops = originalDictionary base heap box ops

theorem observations {O : Sort _} (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (observe : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base) → O) (heap : HeapRequest) (box : BoxRequest)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) :
    observe (selected base heap box ops) = observe (originalDictionary base heap box ops)

theorem heap_nonvacuity (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (w : W) (kappa : Native) :
    ∃ out, @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op251 (types base)
      (selected base (fun _ _ => ok .supplied) (fun _ _ _ => ok ()) ops) w kappa = ok (.Ok out)

theorem box_nonvacuity (base : ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes)
    (ops : @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns (types base)) (v : NV) (alpha : Array NQ 10#usize) (z : Array NP 2#usize) :
    ∃ out, @ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns.op252 (types base)
      (selected base (fun _ _ => ok .supplied) (fun _ _ _ => ok ()) ops) v alpha z = ok (.Ok out)
resource_family_generalization.BoxRequest: NV → Array NQ 10 → Array NP 2 → Result Unit
resource_family_generalization.quantifiers: Every resolver, including input/witness-dependent outcomes; no independence premise. Actual native failure-event witness independence remains a separate P obligation.

final_context.types: PV_B2_F_ConstructorCarrier.types base (exact native weights op25 carrier; all other type fields preserved)
final_context.heap: HeapRequest := W → NativeWideExact → Result Outcome; arbitrary input-dependent family
final_context.box: BoxRequest := NativeVariant → Array NativeQM31 10 → Array NativePoint 2 → Result Unit; arbitrary input-dependent family
final_context.observer: Arbitrary whole-record observer transported by RawNative.dictionaries/observations; physical native observation correspondence remains P
final_context.hidden_premises: No source-equality, validity, canonicality, success or failure-independence hypothesis on complete Result equality

final_audit.scope: Coherent selected source/callback cohort with cached resolved dependencies; separate final combined audit then focused five-row replay

all_five_nonvacuity: For every b/kappa/native variant/raw alpha/raw points, the supplied-success resource families yield one successful constructor weight shared by op251/op253, and both samplers succeed. Exact existential statement is final_full_statements[1].
